name: Konoe Nadeshiko
source:
-Kusunoki Obstetrics and Gynecology Nurse
-Young lady from a wealthy family.
-Lacks experience with men.
- Virgin
-Timid personality 

When she tried to sneak away from the patient, she was discovered by the criminal and raped in front of the hostages, taking advantage of her vulnerable nature.
